column1: # ONE MAN RECORDED TWICE, CONFIRMED BY THE OWNER OF THE TREE, MERGED FOR PUBLICATION WITHOUT EDITING THE TREE (25 October 2026).
# Applied by tools/gedcom.py (apply_merges) on every load, so the generators and the gates see one tree with one man in it.
# The surviving record is the better-sourced one; the retired record's page address redirects to the survivor
# (site/src/data/merged.json, which tools/build_site_data.py writes, read by site/astro.config.mjs); the retired record's name is kept on the
# survivor as «also recorded as»; both records' citations are kept; the build STOPS where the two records give a different date, place,
# cause or sex (nothing is chosen silently). tools/consistency.py reads the tree as exported and applies none of it.
# The identification itself is written on the page What changed (site/src/data/corrections.json, the entry for the survivor).
